question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching become known?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace.
The Kaula determination is now known.
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
plain_english: O lord of Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
